supervisor.value: You must secure a research supervisor before you can be admitted.

also.quote: when a qualified applicant is matched with a supervisor and financial support

entry_route.value: A master's is required; exceptional applicants without one can ask to be considered for direct PhD admission.
entry_route.quote: Admission requires a master's degree (or equivalent) from a recognized university. | applicants (without a master's degree) with exceptionally high Academic Standing and outstanding research potential will be considered for direct admission to the Ph.D. program.
